feed.title: Lectio editions
feed.subtitle: New and revised Lectio editions from the San Diego Institute of Technology.

entry.title: Meditations, Marcus Aurelius: Lectio Edition
entry.summary: A new plain-English translation of the Stoic emperor's private notebook, with Long, Casaubon and the Greek beside it. Beta, open for review.

entry.title: The Iliad, Homer: Lectio Edition
entry.summary: Homer's poem of the rage of Achilles and the war at Troy, in a new plain-English prose translation, with Pope and Butler beside it. Beta.

entry.title: The Odyssey, Homer: Lectio Edition
entry.summary: Homer's poem of Odysseus and his long way home from Troy, in a new plain-English prose translation, with Butler's version beside it. Beta.

entry.title: The Republic, Plato: Lectio Edition
entry.summary: Plato's dialogue on justice, the Cave and the philosopher-king, in a new plain-English translation with Jowett's version beside it. Beta.

entry.title: The Aeneid, Virgil: Lectio Edition
entry.summary: Virgil's epic of Aeneas, the fall of Troy and the founding of Rome, in a new plain-English prose translation with Dryden's beside it. Beta.

entry.title: The Prince, Niccolò Machiavelli: Lectio Edition
entry.summary: Machiavelli's short handbook on winning and keeping power, in a new plain-English translation that keeps the word virtù. Marriott's beside it. Beta.

entry.title: The Analects, Confucius: Lectio Edition
entry.summary: The sayings of Confucius on learning, ritual and becoming fully human, in a new plain-English translation with Legge's version beside it. Beta.

entry.title: The Tao Te Ching, Laozi: Lectio Edition
entry.summary: Laozi's eighty-one chapters on the Way and the power that works by yielding, in a new plain-English translation with Legge's beside it. Beta.

entry.title: The Dhammapada: Lectio Edition
entry.summary: The Buddha's verses on the mind, craving and the path, in a new plain-English translation that follows the Pali, with Müller's beside it. Beta.

entry.title: The Bhagavad Gita: Lectio Edition
entry.summary: Krishna's teaching to Arjuna on duty, devotion and acting without clinging to results, in new plain-English prose with Arnold's verse beside it. Beta.

entry.title: The Epic of Gilgamesh: Lectio Edition
entry.summary: The oldest epic: Gilgamesh, Enkidu and the search for a way not to die. A new plain-English rendering of the eleven tablets. Beta.

entry.title: Nicomachean Ethics, Aristotle: Lectio Edition
entry.summary: Aristotle on happiness, virtue, friendship and the good life, in a new plain-English translation with one word for each key term. Beta.

entry.title: Confessions, Saint Augustine: Lectio Edition
entry.summary: Augustine's account of his restless youth and conversion, and of memory and time, in a new plain-English translation with Pusey's beside it. Beta.

entry.title: The Divine Comedy, Dante Alighieri: Lectio Edition
entry.summary: Dante's journey through Hell, Purgatory and Paradise, all 100 cantos, in a new plain-English translation set tercet by tercet. Beta.

entry.title: Hamlet, William Shakespeare: Lectio Edition
entry.summary: Shakespeare's tragedy with its verse and famous lines kept, and only dead words and tangled grammar cleared. A companion to the original. Beta.

entry.title: The Gospel of Mark: Lectio Edition
entry.summary: The earliest Gospel in a new plain-English translation that keeps Mark's speed, his repeated "right away" and his abrupt ending. Beta.

entry.title: Genesis: Lectio Edition
entry.summary: Creation, the flood, Abraham and Joseph, in a new plain-English translation that keeps the Hebrew's refrains, with the King James beside it. Beta.
